verdict.rationale: RUN documents an AI-powered virtual assistant that answers payroll and HR questions in natural language (adp-run-docs-16), so there is a first-party natural-language interface. However, the evidence shows only question-answering, not natural-language commands that perform actions such as running payroll or changing employee records. ADP Assist for API Central (adp-run-docs-34) is a developer-side tool, and nothing says it accepts natural-language instructions. Missing for 10: evidence that natural-language commands execute product actions (running payroll, adding employees, generating reports), documentation of the assistant's scope and depth, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
